content.text: Everything you need to know about TV’s hottest new dating show If you’re a dating show fan, step aboard this all-new reality romance with a twist. Love Overboard takes the classic dating show setup and drops it on a gorgeous yacht, but it’s not exactly smooth sailing. Read on for the release date, cast info, and how to watch.All About Love Overboard On HuluA group of hopeful singles step aboard a luxury yacht ready to mix, mingle, and find love, but there’s a hitch. Contestants will have to earn access to the boat’s extravagant amenities. As their journey unfolds, romance ignites, alliances form, and hearts are broken. In the end, only one couple will reign supreme. Who will rise to the top and who will be left stranded?Love Overboard is set to stream on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ for bundle subscribers.*Love Overboard On Hulu Release DateLove Overboard premieres with all episodes on Thursday, March 26, 2026, on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ for bundle subscribers.*Love Overboard On Hulu CastThe show is hosted by reality TV icon Gabby Windey. Known for her appearances on The Bachelor, The Traitors, and Dancing With the Stars, she’s no stranger to drama. Alex Cooper and Jeff Jenkins are executive producers.*Available for U.S. residents, 18+ only. Location data required to watch certain content.
